basic_profile.bio: A 24-year-old student based in Toronto, juggling life between university studies and a part-time job at a local cafe. Passionate about learning new skills, especially in locksmithing, which I've been exploring through online resources and occasional workshops. I enjoy the vibrant university life, although I prefer quiet evenings with a good book or a DIY project. Typically online during late evenings after classes and work. Currently single and focusing on personal growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Currently pursuing a degree in Philosophy at the University of Toronto, with a growing interest in practical skills like locksmithing, fueled by online tutorials and hands-on practice. Also has a keen interest in philosophical discussions and frequently engages in related subreddit threads.
